pure-announcement.rationale: It is a vendor thought-leadership report, not a product launch, release note, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: siem-agentic-visibility-gap touches telemetry for agents but none of the supplied concepts covers this report's prediction set or the data-tiering/vendor-consolidation material.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The central claims are five quantified forecasts ('35% of enterprises by 2027', '90% of production AI deployments will fail', '20% of Fortune 2000', '15% will switch platforms') offered with no methodology, survey, or primary source — the reference list backs only background facts, and the sole 'Gartner' citation actually links to a Grand View Research market report.

durability.rationale: The report is structured around dated forecast percentages that will be adjudicated or stale by 2027; only generic patterns (data tiering, telemetry as attack surface, data independence) would outlive the prediction frame.

actionability.rationale: Its recommendations stay at directional vendor-pitch level — 'adopt data tiering', 'keep humans in the loop', 'prioritise data independence' — with no mechanism or threshold a reader could implement.

atomicity.rationale: Five unrelated predictions spanning budgets, pipeline security, data-tier scaling, procurement, and private-credit macroeconomics are bundled with no single extractable core idea.
